name: SEO
description: Daily SEO task, post checks, Search Console and search preview.
reads: Your sites' files; Search Console and validator.schema.org when you use them; the pages and share images in your sitemaps when you check link previews

settings.label: Sites
settings.hint: The first one shows in Today. Each site: id, name, domain; optionally property, file (daily task and ideas; if empty data/seo/<id>.json), blogFolder (each post in its own folder as post.md), reportsFolder (kontrol-*.md), project and list (SEO task list); sitemaps (extra sitemap addresses for the link preview check; robots.txt is read too); local (your dev server, e.g. http://localhost:5000, to check link previews before publishing; subdomains open as <sub>.localhost)

settings.label: Search Console credentials folder
settings.hint: search-console-istemci.json and search-console-belirtec.json go here. If empty, data/apps/seo
